flashback3d.desc.breakout: Forced perspective. Viewable on any phone, no glasses. Depth comes from real engine geometry.
flashback3d.desc.wobble: Camera sways side to side; near objects move more than far ones. Zero rendering cost, stacks with any layout.
flashback3d.desc.anaglyph: True stereo. Needs paper red-cyan glasses. Color loss is unavoidable.
flashback3d.desc.corner: Two angled physical screens. Standard for outdoor 3D billboards.
flashback3d.warn.untested: This Flashback version is unverified and may malfunction
flashback3d.warn.tooold: Flashback version too old, 3D export disabled
